analysis.caption: Extended text — structure and repetition patterns matter.

parsed.executive_summary: Students spend an average of 7.23 hours gaming and 8.78 hours studying, but without significant correlations or additional data, deeper insights into relationships between these activities and academic success are limited.

predictive_insights.insight: Students generally spend a significant amount of time gaming and studying, with varying levels of sleep and social activity.
predictive_insights.actionable_recommendation: Collect additional data on student performance to identify potential relationships between gaming, studying, sleep, and academic success.

quantitative_analysis.statistical_summary: The data lacks significant linear correlations, with all Pearson correlation coefficients having an absolute value less than 0.3, and without additional statistical information, meaningful distributions and averages are difficult to interpret.
